name: Men's 2-Piece Training Set, Tee and Shorts
description: A short-sleeve training top and shorts, sold as one set, in three looks: neon-green side panel, plain black and a grey muscle-line print. The shorts have a grey reflective-style stripe on the leg. Thin fabric; the supplier describes it as quick-drying. The supplier gave no size chart: if you are between sizes, go one up.

source.notes: Supplier title: Cross-Border Quick-Drying Fitness Clothing Suit Men's Sports Tights Five-Piece Running Breathable High-Elastic Basketball Training Suit. One 1688 offer (922748551668) with 33 styles at ¥12.8 to ¥58.8 per set (about ₦2,848 to ₦13,084 on the screenshot, fx 222.52); the real ¥ price per set size is NOT shown and unconfirmed. Owner said ¥60: used as one conservative cost for all three sets (above the top of the ¥12.8-58.8 range). Update when real per-set prices are known. 200+ sets sold, 100+ reviews (one says it is just not cool enough). Spot goods, thin, sport style. Sizes S, M, L, XL shown; no size chart; sizes S-XL taken from the screenshot, fit note assumed. Weights 900/903/1004/1006 g read like the five-piece set, not this one; L packed 35 x 29.7 x 9.5 cm: weight for this set unknown. Freight hint: consolidation air to Nigeria at ¥8.7 per 0.1 kg (first and additional). Store return rate not shown. Fabric not stated: quick-dry is supplier wording only. Source photos are 800 px, so store photos are scaled up and a little soft. Tights' waistband shows PRO COMBAT (a Nike line) in the supplier photos: the text was retouched out to a plain band; the 1688 main image (not used) has a model in swoosh trainers and Chinese text. 2-piece photos show no tights, so no waistband text. The ¥60 unit cost is a placeholder: confirm the real per-set cost with the supplier before reordering. Price raised from NGN 25000 to NGN 33500 on 13 Nov 2026 (owner: every price carries its freight and card fee and keeps 45%; weight-based freight estimate).
